切歌只下发被取走的歌曲与播放快照，不再同步整份等待队列。

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "user.update",
  "requestId": "user",
  "data": {
    "name": "alice",
    "email": " A@B.C ",
    "clientTimeMs": 100
  }
}

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.pick",
  "requestId": "pick-current",
  "data": {
    "source": "qq",
    "id": "current"
  }
}

-- setup --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "music.pick",
  "requestId": "pick-next",
  "data": {
    "source": "qq",
    "id": "next"
  }
}

-- request --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "request",
  "type": "playback.skipVote",
  "requestId": "skip",
  "data": {}
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "response",
  "type": "playback.skipVote",
  "requestId": "skip",
  "data": {
    "currentVotes": 1,
    "requiredVotes": 1,
    "skipped": true
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",
  "type": "queue.removed",
  "data": {
    "id": "next",
    "source": "qq"
  }
}

-- response --
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "event",
  "type": "playback.updated",
  "data": {
    "song": {
      "id": "next",
      "source": "qq",
      "name": "同名歌曲",
      "artist": "artist",
      "album": "",
      "durationMs": 3600000,
      "pictureUrl": "",
      "webUrl": "",
      "url": "https://example.invalid/next",
      "lyric": "[00:00]lyric"
    },
    "user": {
      "name": "alice",
      "emailHash": "5d60d4e28066df254d5452f92c910092"
    },
    "startedAtMs": 1,
    "volumeCoefficient": 0.75
  }
}
